svg.title: Figure 2: Request flow for one tool call
svg.desc: The agent logs in to Vault with AppRole and gets an identity token (1), then sends tools/call to agentgateway (2). Inside the gateway, jwtAuth checks the token against Vault's public keys (3), mcpGuardrails checks the arguments (4), and mcpAuthorization checks the tool (5). The gateway forwards the call to the MCP server with x-api-key (6). The MCP server checks the upstream key (7). The tool reads database/creds from the Vault database secrets engine (8) and connects to Postgres as the leased user (9).
